test_policy.notes: 'We do not require SAT or ACT scores, though students who believe their scores represent a positive component of their admissions portfolio are invited to submit them.' An older counselor handout says scores are strongly recommended for merit-scholarship consideration; the current undergraduate page does not repeat that.

requirements.notes: Mercyhurst's own application is described as free (apply.mercyhurst.edu); the Common App and Coalition application are also accepted. International undergraduates submit the online application, official transcripts in English and proof of English proficiency, then upload a bank affidavit, certification of finances and passport photo page to the Admissions Portal. Transfer students from non-U.S. universities also need a certified credit evaluation (WES, ECE or SpanTran). Dance and Music applicants need an audition (older counselor handout). F-1 students are automatically billed for the university health insurance plan unless they have qualifying U.S. coverage.

deadlines.label: Rolling admission (fall 2027 entry): no international undergraduate deadline published
deadlines.notes: The undergraduate page says admission is rolling and the sooner you apply the sooner you hear back; no date is printed. An older, undated counselor handout lists March 1 as a recommended application date, with offers released weekly from late September and a May 1 confirmation date; that is not repeated on the current site, so it is not recorded as a deadline. Allow time for the I-20 and visa.

english_policy.waiver_notes: The international page says 'students with demonstrated English proficiency are invited to apply' and lists the accepted tests; it names no waivers or exemptions. Contact the International Student Office (iso@mercyhurst.edu, 814-824-3059) about exemptions; no ESL or conditional-admission pathway is described.

english.notes: Minimum 17.25 in each section. TOEFL Essentials is also accepted (8.0 overall and 8.0 each section) but is not a selectable test here. The page gives no value for the new 1-6 TOEFL scale.
Minimum 5.8 overall and 5.8 in each section.
Minimum 100 overall and 100 in each section.

aid.notes: The international page says scholarships for international students are awarded to those 'with strong high school academic achievements and financial need'; no amounts, number of awards or application steps are published for internationals. The financial aid page says institutional scholarships go up to $25,000 but does not say whether international students are eligible. International students are not eligible for federal aid.

cost.notes: Estimated 2026-27 residential cost from the financial aid page: basic tuition $45,900 (flat for 12-18 credits), standard fees $2,930, housing $6,154 (Baldwin/McAuley Hall double) plus Laker Unlimited meals $7,562 = $13,716. One-time orientation ($280) and ID ($50) fees are excluded; the page totals $62,876 with them. Warde Hall/Mercy suite housing is $8,848. F-1 students are also billed the health insurance plan (amount not published on the page).

sat.note: No SAT code is printed on the admissions pages.

act.note: No ACT code is printed on the admissions pages.

toefl.note: No TOEFL institution code is printed on the admissions pages.
